lines.intro: A puppy in a red cap zooms out from behind the pond, barking at everything!

soothe.great: Fae speaks softly: "Easy, buddy." The pup's swirly eyes start to slow down!
soothe.good: Fae speaks softly. The pup tilts his head and listens.
soothe.miss: Fae tries, but the pup is too zoomy to hear much.

play.great: Maddie bats a tennis ball across the grass. The pup races after it, tail wagging!
play.good: Maddie nudges a tennis ball. The pup can't resist a sniff.
play.miss: Maddie swats at a ball... and it bonks her on the nose. The pup gives a puppy grin.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber across the grass. The pup races after it, tail wagging!
cast.good: Sue's bobber wiggles by. The pup tilts his head and wags.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber snags on the fence. The pup gives it a curious sniff.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. Energy up! The pup licks his lips.
lines.burst: The pup barks and bats a flurry of tennis balls at Fae!

burstResult.great: Boing, boing! Fae catches every single ball!
burstResult.good: Fae catches most of the balls!
burstResult.miss: Bonk! The balls bounce all around Fae.

lines.soothed: The pup flops down with a happy sigh. The zoomy spell floats away!
lines.rest: Fae is all tuckered out. Time for a little rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away slowly. The pup keeps zooming around the pond.
